status.description: Standing of the edge, weakest first. otcs_observed is BELOW self_asserted: the registry asserted this about projects that have not spoken, so it is the only status where neither named party has said anything. self_asserted means one side claimed it; mutually_confirmed requires the counterparty to sign off; independently_verified requires a party neither side controls.

non_claims.description: What this edge explicitly does NOT assert — 'no derivation established', 'no equivalence established'. Required on otcs_observed edges: an unbounded registry assertion about a project that has not been asked is the exact harm the observed record state exists to contain.

observed_source.description: Public material the observation was drawn from. Where it came from, so the subject can check it.

subject_notified.description: Whether the named projects have been told this edge exists. False is honest; absent is not.
